open_points.subject: plan_run operation ElementFailed conclusion mapping
open_points.text: wherever a rule below reads an element's or a node's conclusion in the imported NODE_CONCLUSION_EFFECTS constant, ElementSucceeded reads as succeeded, ElementWaiting as waiting and ElementFailed as the conclusion of the EXECUTION_STATUS_CONCLUSIONS row of its status;
open_points.other_text: an operation element's is operation_element_conclusion of its element under the context — ElementFailed is failed whatever its status — operation_failed, operation_refused, outcome_unknown or another —, except an ElementFailed whose status is skipped_by_guard or upstream_failed, which answers such a record and concludes as the record does;
open_points.question: Must an operation ElementFailed be normalized to failed except for skipped_by_guard and upstream_failed, or must its conclusion always come from the EXECUTION_STATUS_CONCLUSIONS row for its status?
